_comment: Auth/header-only listing keeps envelope, order and owned_by with router facts. Baseline RED on router paths.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "required"
api_keys = ["client-secret"]
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
name: m4_capability_static_auth_required
